identificationModule.briefTitle: Futibatinib (TAS-120) in Patients With Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized-Controlled, Open-Label, Multi-Regional, International Study of Futibatinib (TAS-120) and Zimberelimab (AB122) in Combination With Gemcitabine Plus Cisplatin Versus Durvalumab or Pembrolizumab in Combination With Gemcitabine Plus Cisplatin for Patients With First-Line Advanced Biliary Tract Cancers

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To compare overall survival (OS) of patients in Futibatinib and Zimberelimab in Combination with Gemcitabine plus Cisplatin versus Durvalumab or Pembrolizumab in Combination with Gemcitabine plus Cisplatin for patients with first-line advanced biliary tract cancer

armGroups.label: Control Arm
armGroups.description: Investigator's choice; Durvalumab or Pembrolizumab + Gemcitabine + Cisplatin

interventions.name: Futibatinib
interventions.description: Futibatinib 20 mg will be administered orally once daily.

interventions.name: Zimberelimab
interventions.description: Zimberelimab 360 mg will be administered on Day 1 of each 3-week cycle (Q3W) by intravenous infusion.

interventions.name: Durvalumab
interventions.description: Durvalumab 1500 mg will be administered on Day 1 of Q3W by intravenous infusion.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Pembrolizumab 200 mg will be administered on Day 1 of Q3W by intravenous infusion.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 will be administered Days 1 and 8 of Q3W by intravenous infusion.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: Cisplatin 25 mg/m2 will be administered Days 1 and 8 of Q3W by intravenous infusion.

primaryOutcomes.description:
* To compare OS of patients in Arm A versus Arm B for patients with first-line advanced BTC whose primary tumor site is intrahepatic or extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
* To compare OS of patients in Arm A versus Arm B for patients with first-line advanced BTC

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) version 1.1 using Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR) and Investigator assessment
6-months PFS rate according to RECIST v1.1 using BICR and Investigator assessments
Objective response rate (ORR) according to RECIST v1.1 using BICR and Investigator assessments
Duration of response (DoR) according to RECIST v1.1 using BICR and Investigator assessments

locations.facility: National Hospital Organization Kyushu Cancer Center
